_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Condition Found Report
summary: The Condition Found Report is used by the Government to identify needed repairs and recommend corrective action for work discovered during contract performance that is not covered by the work specifications.
use_relationship:
The Condition Found Report (CFR) will be used by the Government to identify needed repairs and recommend corrective action for work discovered during the contract performance period, which are not covered by the work specifications. The CFR specifies if the issue has a technical, cost, or schedule impact and recommends corrective action.
This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract.
This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-81648.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The CFR shall be in a format similar to Sample Figure 1 below. If there is a cost impact to the CFR, cost details shall be provided in a separate accompanying document; contractor format shall be acceptable for the cost impact.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be serialized by CFR Number, and shall include the following:

children.title: Title of CFR, project name, contract number, task order number, ship name, and hull number
Work Item Number to which the CFR relates
Specific location of the work requirement
Date work requirement was discovered, date CFR was submitted, requested response date, period of performance end date of the contract
Impact type (Technical, Schedule, Cost, or any combination of all three) and clear description of the impact
Recommendation if a Liaison Action Request (LAR) or Period of Performance (PoP) extension is required to resolve the issue
Clear description of the work requirement
Recommendation for appropriate or best time to accomplish the corrective action
children.content: (i.e. during current availability with or without schedule change, future CNO or Continuous Maintenance Availability), and supporting rationale for the recommendation (such as: cost efficiencies, availability of work force, availability of material, premium expenditures, etc.).

children.title: Cost and time estimates and the time frame for which it is valid
Class "C" cost estimates.
children.content: For work requirements that could be estimated within five working days, a class "F" estimate (+/-40%) identifying any potential impact to the current schedule shall be included. The Class "F" estimate shall also contain the date on which a class "C" estimate is provided.

children.title: Estimated Premium/Acceleration Costs
children.content: including premium costs for material, subcontractors, man-hours, rework, and any additional costs to ongoing work resulting from inclusion of the CFR work requirement.

children.title: Identification of related changes
children.content: if any, to the internal milestones and production and contract completion dates shall be included. When no changes were required a statement to that fact shall also be included.

children.title: If the CFR has a cost impact, detailed financial information shall accompany the CFR.
CFR serial number which the cost impact document is accompanying.
Financial details of the contract broken out by Contract Line Item Number (CLIN)
children.content: to include: ceiling awarded for each CLIN, funding obligated on each CLIN to date, and estimated weekly expenditures (burn curve) per CLIN.

children.title: Detailed breakdown of the estimated costs.
children.content: For cost estimates that include labor expenses, this breakdown shall include description of labor category, quantity of hours per labor category, hourly cost per labor category, total cost per labor category, and total labor cost (including any added fees). For cost estimates that include Other Documented Cost (ODC) expenses, this breakdown shall include a description of each expense, unit of measurement of each expense, cost per unit, quantity of units, total cost per expense, and total ODC cost (including any added fees).

preparation_instructions.title: Media.
preparation_instructions.content: The electronic media requirements shall be as specified on the DD 1423 CDRL.
